style_vocabulary: Grounded utilitarian industrial science fiction; late-20th-century analog technology translated into space; heavy serviceable construction; matte desaturated painted alloy; dark oxidized steel; black rubber seals; restrained safety-yellow accents; asymmetrical field repairs; localized corrosion and grime; large readable forms; readable from a high locked-isometric camera.
neutral_presentation: No environment, no floor, no cast shadow, no readable text, no logo, no floating parts, no duplicate components, no dramatic perspective, no depth of field, no baked lighting.
texture_guidance: Reuse the style_vocabulary for grounded derelict spacecraft materials; keep surfaces PBR, low-gloss, and readable at medium scale; concentrate grime in seams and hand-contact areas; use manual emission masks where needed; do not bake lighting, shadows, logos, or readable text.
